hotel_name: Ava Hotels And Corporates Millennium City

positive_snippets:
I had a very wonderful stay at this hotel. Everything was perfect and I am very happy with my visit.

The Hotel
The rooms are very clean and big. The staff is very polite and helpful. The hotel is in a great location and feels very comfortable. It is a very nice place to stay with friends or for work.

Special Thanks to Purshotam Ji
I want to say a big thank you to the manager, Purshotam Ji. He is a very kind and professional person. He takes care of every guest personally. He made sure that my stay was smooth and easy. His management is excellent, and he is very hardworking.
I highly recommend this hotel to everyone!

Overall, my stay at AVA Hotel Gurgaon was quite good. The rooms are very nice and spacious, and the ambience is pleasant with a premium feel. The services are top-notch, and the front desk staff is polite, helpful, and professional.

The gym area is decent and usable. However, there is a small issue with the lift—it sometimes works and sometimes doesn’t, which needs improvement.

Outside food is allowed, and you can easily order food to your room, which is very convenient. The buffet costs ₹599 per head, but the food options are limited, so it feels average for a single meal. The complimentary morning breakfast is okay.

The rooms offer many services that make the stay comfortable. Overall, the ambience, room quality, and services are good.

Recommended for a comfortable stay.

Nice hotel with great amenities and great staff. Loved the experience. Had a great experience.
Thank you for great service to mr. Purshottam (manager) at ava.
